senses.definition: n.[m.] a (triangular) stringed instrument (Gk. ψαλτήριον, Kraussi. 12, 99, 101; ii. 473 PrinceEB 3232 Dr Dn 58, and on 3, 5);—פ׳ Dn 3:7, פְּסַנְתֵּרִין v 5, 10, 15.
